sentences.en: Automatically inflating jackets are the best in terms of comfort.

sentences.en: If his bellows had only a single opening, that through which they delivered the blast upon the fire, then in inflating them he would draw back into them the hot air and ashes from the fire.
sentences.vi: Nếu ống thổi của anh ta chỉ có một lỗ duy nhất, mà thông qua đó chúng phát ra vụ nổ vào ngọn lửa, thì khi thổi phồng chúng lên, anh ta sẽ hút lại không khí nóng và tro tàn từ ngọn lửa vào chúng.

sentences.en: While inflating the bellows he would leave the suction port open and close the discharge port with a pinch of his finger; and while blowing the air against the fire he would leave the discharge port open and pinch together the sides of the suction port.
sentences.vi: Trong khi thổi phồng ống thổi, anh ta sẽ để cổng hút mở và đóng cổng xả bằng một nhúm ngón tay; và trong khi thổi không khí vào ngọn lửa, anh ta sẽ để hở cổng xả và kẹp các cạnh của cổng hút lại với nhau.

sentences.en: Ironically, the 1992 Cultural Studies anthology often receives more criticism for inflating the field than less critically self-aware collections.

sentences.en: In the first group we have to notice the use of iron or zinc and dilute sulphuric acid for the manufacture of hydrogen, which may be used directly, as for inflating balloons or for purposes of combustion, or in the nascent condition, for reduction purposes, as generally is the case in organic chemistry (see Aniline).

sentences.en: Be prepared to provide ownership papers that verify the cost you paid for the dog, so potential buyers do not think you are inflating the price.

sentences.en: Children 12 and under should ride in the back seat in order to avoid being hurt by inflating airbags.
